content: We must be our own before we can be another's.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Healthy relationships require sovereign individuals. Attempting to complete yourself through another creates codependency; mutual sovereignty creates genuine communion.
practicalInsight: Cultivate your own internal grounding and self-respect so that you bring fullness to your relationships.
reflectionPrompt: Are you showing up in relationships as a whole sovereign soul or as a needy fragment?
